privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.sub: What is saved, where, and what leaves the phone
privacy.device: Without signing in, your trip data stays only on this device, in the browser's storage (localStorage). There is no server, and nobody else sees it.
privacy.photos: Photos are saved on the device too, in a separate browser store (IndexedDB). They are not in the regular backup; they have their own ZIP file.
privacy.host: The app loads from a site on GitHub Pages, and a copy is kept on the device so it works offline. As with any site, the host sees that the files were loaded (an IP address, for example). Your data is not sent to it.
privacy.links: Nothing goes out unless you tap: "Open in Google Maps" sends Google the place's location or address. Calls, sharing and links you typed also open only on tap.
privacy.location: "My location" is read from the phone once, on tap, and is not saved unless you tap "Save".
privacy.dont: Do not keep passport numbers, credit card details or passwords here. The data is not encrypted.
privacy.wipe: Clearing the site's data in the browser deletes all your data, and removing the app from the home screen may delete it too. So back up: a JSON backup and a ZIP for photos, kept off the phone.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.personal: A tool for personal use between friends. Free, no ads, no data collection.
terms.asis: The app is provided as is, with no warranty. It may contain mistakes and bugs.
terms.info: The information here (numbers, addresses, budgets and rates) is for help only. Anything marked "to check" is not verified yet. Before an important decision, check an official source.
terms.data: Your data and backups are your responsibility. Feedback and bugs: in the WhatsApp group.

info.insurance.lead: No insurance bought yet. Cover, arrangement, pre-approval and direct billing: not verified. Note the policy details here once you have them.
info.more.title: Thai phrases and conduct
info.userGiven: Given by the user on {date}. Not checked against an official source.
info.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy by hand.
info.note.title: My notes
info.note.label: My notes: {name}
info.note.hint: Saved only on this phone and included in the backup.
info.field.name: Name
info.field.nameTh: Name in Thai (to show a driver)
info.field.addressTh: Address in Thai (to show a driver)
tip.label: About {name}
tip.freeBefore.name: Free before planning
tip.freeBefore.text: The running budget less what was paid and what is set aside for the flight until it is paid. Emergency is apart.
tip.freeAfter.name: Free after planning
tip.freeAfter.text: The budget less every expense and what is set aside for the flight until it is entered. This is what is left.
tip.planned.name: Planned
tip.planned.text: Spending you intend to make and have not committed to yet. It already comes off "free after planning".
tip.committed.name: Future commitment
tip.committed.text: Money you have committed to that leaves later, such as a hotel balance. It comes off "free after planning" before it is paid.
tip.today.name: Free today
tip.today.text: Free after planning, divided by the days left including today. By the clock at the destination.
tip.base.name: Daily base
tip.base.text: The budget without the flight, divided by the trip dates. A starting point for planning, not a limit.
tip.emergency.name: Emergency fund
tip.emergency.text: A separate amount for emergencies. Not part of "free" or "free today".
tip.rates.name: Rates
tip.rates.text: The rates here are fixed for planning and are not updated from the network. The rate when you pay may differ.
tip.backup.name: Backup and restore
tip.backup.text: One JSON file with all the data: trip, budget, lists and notes. No photos.
tip.photoBackup.name: Photo backup
tip.photoBackup.text: Photos go to a separate ZIP file because they are heavy. A full restore needs both files.
tip.unverified.name: Not verified yet
tip.unverified.text: No checked official source was found. Check it yourself before relying on it.
tip.userProvided.name: Given by the user
tip.userProvided.text: This detail came from you and was not checked against a source. The app only keeps it.
tip.verify.name: To check
tip.verify.text: Rules change, so this is not written as fact. Check an official source and note where and when.
tip.flex.name: Flexible stop
tip.flex.text: A stop that can be made longer or shorter. "Change the flexible stop" changes only this one.
tip.placeDates.name: Planned day and visit date
tip.placeDates.text: The planned day is when you plan to go. The actual visit date is only typed by hand, after the visit.
sbag.title: Smart suitcase
sbag.lead: Suggestions only, by days, stops and activities. Nothing is added to the lists without a tap.
sbag.days: {days} days. Clothes for up to {cap} days, since you can do laundry on the way.
sbag.noDates: No trip dates yet. Quantities are for {cap} days.
sbag.unclassified: Not classified, so no suggestions by stop: {list}
sbag.none: No suggestions here. What fits is already in the lists.
sbag.where: What you add goes into the lists, under "Suitcase" or "Carry-on". There you can edit the amount and tick it when it is ready.
total.label: How much money do you have for the trip?
total.err: Type a whole amount in shekels, e.g. 15,000.
money.details.title: Details
suggest.title: Suggested split
suggest.note: A suggestion only, not an expense. You can change everything, also after approving.
suggest.paidFlight: Flight already paid? Add it as an expense, and its amount is no longer set aside.
suggest.replace: The current category amounts will be replaced. The emergency fund stays.
suggest.applied: Split saved. You can change it any time.
money.emergencyInside: The emergency fund of {em} is part of your {base} budget. It is set aside and not part of "free".
money.cat.emergencyInside: Part of the budget. Set aside, not part of "free" until it is used.
privacy.cloud: Signing in is optional. After an admin approves the account, trips are also kept on Supabase's server in Singapore, and sync between your devices.
privacy.cloudWho: Friends you share a trip with see only the shared part: route, places, flight details, participants and shared expenses. Your budget, flight price, lists, journal and check-ins stay personal.
privacy.cloudAdmin: The app's admin can see all the data on the server, to approve users and fix problems.
privacy.cloudPhotos: Photos are not uploaded. They stay only on the device.
privacy.cloudDelete: A trip owner can delete the trip from the account in settings ("Delete trip"). The copy on the device stays. To delete your account and all its data from the server, ask the admin. Data on the device stays until you delete it yourself.
cloud.title: My account and trips
cloud.off: Cloud sync is not set up yet. Everything is kept on this device.
cloud.signedOut: Your data is kept on this device. Signing in adds sync between devices and sharing with friends. It is optional.
cloud.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to sync. Nothing on this device was lost.
cloud.pending: Waiting for an admin to approve you. Until then everything stays on this device.
cloud.blocked: This account is blocked. Nothing on this device was lost.
cloud.restore.text: You restored a backup. Where should it go?
cloud.restore.deviceDone: The restore stays on this device. The trip no longer syncs, and the cloud copy is unchanged.
cloud.f.name: Name (optional)
cloud.f.phone: Phone (optional, not used to sign in)
cloud.toSignin: I have an account: sign in
cloud.hint.signin: Signing in adds sync. Without a connection, everything keeps working on the device.
cloud.hint.signup: A new account waits for an admin to approve it. Until then everything stays on the device.
cloud.hint.reset: Reset links go only to addresses the admin set up. Friends: ask the admin for a manual reset.
cloud.hint.newpass: Choose a new password for your account.
cloud.reset.sent: If the address is allowed, a link was sent. If nothing arrives, ask the admin for a manual reset.
cloud.signup.checkMail: We sent an email to confirm the address. After confirming, sign in.
cloud.signout.done: Signed out. Your data stayed on the device.
cloud.err.email: A valid email address is needed.
cloud.err.short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
cloud.err.exists: There is already an account with this email. You can sign in.
cloud.err.offline: No connection to the server right now. Data is kept on the device and syncs when the connection is back.
cloud.err.auth: Your session ended. Sign in again.
cloud.err.denied: You are not allowed to do this.
cloud.err.bad: Something did not work. Try again.
cloud.err.taken: This trip already belongs to another account. It stays on the device.
cloud.share.hint: Your friend needs an approved account. They will see only the shared part of the trip.
cloud.share.notFound: No approved user with this email. Ask your friend to sign up, and the admin to approve them.
cloud.members.hintOwner: Only you, as the trip owner, add and remove members and change dates.
cloud.members.hintMember: The trip owner adds and removes members and changes dates.
cloud.members.removeText: Remove {who} from the trip? The copy already on their device is not deleted.
cloud.members.leaveText: Leave the trip? The copy on this device stays but no longer syncs.
cloud.delete.title: Delete trip
cloud.delete.what: This deletes from your account: {stops} stops, {expenses} expenses, {items} list items, {places} places and everything else in the trip. Trip members lose access too.
cloud.delete.stays: The copy on this device stays, marked "this device only". Copies on your friends' phones stay too. Photos are not in the cloud and are not affected.
cloud.delete.final: Deleting from the account cannot be undone.
cloud.delete.ask: Are you sure you want to delete this trip?
cloud.delete.done: Trip deleted from your account. The copy on this device stays.
cloud.delete.fail.offline: No connection to the server. The trip was not deleted. Try again when you are online.
cloud.delete.fail.auth: Your session ended. The trip was not deleted. Sign in and try again.
cloud.delete.fail.denied: You are not allowed to delete this trip. Only its owner can. The trip was not deleted.
cloud.delete.fail.bad: Something went wrong. The trip was not deleted. Try again.
cloud.members.left: You left the trip. The copy on this device stays.
cloud.migrate.title: Move the trip to your account?
cloud.migrate.hint: Two steps: first download a backup file. Then come back here and tap "Move to my account now". Photos stay on the phone. You can try again with no duplicates.
cloud.migrate.ready: The backup downloaded. Once you saved it, come back here and tap "Move to my account now".
cloud.migrate.uploading: Moving the trip to your account. Please keep the app open.
cloud.migrate.fail.create: The trip was not created in your account. {reason} Nothing changed on the device, and you can try again.
cloud.migrate.fail.records: The trip was created in your account, but its data was not sent. {reason} Nothing changed on the device. You can try again, with no duplicates.
cloud.sync.offline: Offline. Changes are kept on the device and sent when the connection is back.
cloud.notice.replaced: A change of yours was replaced by a newer one. A copy is kept on the device.
cloud.notice.datesOwnerOnly: Only the trip owner changes the dates. Their dates are back.
cloud.notice.lost: A trip is no longer shared with you. The copy stays on the device.
cloud.notice.deleted: A trip was deleted from your account. The copy on this device stays.
cloud.datesOwnerOnly: Only the trip owner changes the trip dates.
cloud.admin.blockText: Block {who}? Blocking stops their access to the account and the trips on the server. It does not delete the account, the trips or any data, and it can be undone.
cloud.notice.tooBig: One item is too big for the cloud. It stays on the phone.

toolsTab.lead: The whole trip at a glance
trip.new.title: New trip
trip.new.hint: The trip is made on this device only, empty. Your other trips do not change. You can move it to the account later.
trip.new.name: Trip name
trip.new.err: The trip needs a name, up to 60 characters.
trip.new.done: The trip is made and shown now. On this device only.
cloud.admin.addText: Add {who} to "{trip}"? They will see the shared part of the trip. You can remove them later.
cloud.admin.added: The user was added to the trip
cloud.admin.addNotApproved: The user is not approved yet. Approve them first.
cloud.admin.approveFirst: To add them to a trip, approve them first.
cloud.share.hintAccount: Making an account does not add your friend to the trip. After the admin approves them, add them here by email.
